finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::`login` labels every backend failure `unauthorized`, contradicting the documented error matrix (5xx → system) and the exit-code column
evidence: Verified in the supplied packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts: all three `failFromBackend` call sites (exchange, /auth/me, /workspaces) pass a hard-coded fallback `code: 'UNAUTHORIZED'` irrespective of HTTP status, and the /workspaces one even interpolates `HTTP ${wsRes.status}` into the message while still coding it UNAUTHORIZED. Since `backendErrorEnvelope` only takes an upstream `code` when the body has a nested `error` *object*, Nest's default `{statusCode, message, error: "Internal Server Error"}` for a 5xx falls through to the fallback, so a 500 is emitted to agents as `UNAUTHORIZED` — a stable-but-wrong code on exactly the field #661 tells agents to branch on. `failFromBackend` also ends in `process.exit(1)` while packages/cli/README.md (touched by this PR) documents exit `2` for auth/system errors, though that exit-code mismatch pre-dates this change. I could not read docs/design/cli.md §10 itself (not supplied), so the exact matrix wording/line numbers are unverified, but the code-level mislabeling is real.
